the_blocker_this_removed.prior_claim: GUI/DOM arming is blocked: this sandbox has no display
the_blocker_this_removed.measurement: FALSE. Headless Chromium runs here. Obtained from the reachable npm registry (@sparticuz/chromium ships chromium.br inside the package) via the repository's own canonical/runtime/browser_launch_v1.sh, which already did exactly this. Two real obstacles existed and both were small: (1) browser_v1.ensure() demanded an SPKI pin for every host, which is a category error for a loopback HTTP page and made every local app unreachable -- fixed by a host list; (2) the CDP snapshot reported the placeholder as the accessible name, so 1 of 11 apps was unaddressable and the other 10 were addressable only by luck.

two_seam_changes: canonical/runtime/browser_v1.py -- _is_local(): a loopback page has no TLS peer, so it has nothing to pin; ensure([]) means no pins and already existed

canonical/runtime/osworld_v21_browser_cdp_v1.py -- four NAME-addressed ops (FILL_NAME, PRESS_NAME, CLICK_NAME, TOGGLE_NAME) and an aria_name field in the snapshot; every other op on that surface takes a CSS selector, which is a guess at internal structure

benchmark.family: TodoMVC, the prebuilt implementations of a published interface specification

task_multi_step.goal: add a todo, mark it complete, then filter to Completed
task_multi_step.verification: the URL is the postcondition: 11/11 moved to #/completed

the_three_findings.evidence: aria snapshot 253 bytes / 123 ms vs screenshot 9,601 bytes / 1280x720; and the tree published the postcondition after the action ('text: buy milk', 'strong: "1"', 'text: item left') with nothing in this module knowing what those mean

the_three_findings.finding: The interface has no single name, and assuming one costs real apps
the_three_findings.evidence: preferring aria_name emptied backbone's address and broke 8 of 11 that had been passing; preferring placeholder broke the 3 with real labels. The address must be the ordered list the interface publishes. Net effect measured: 3/11 then 11/11 after the fix.

the_three_findings.finding: Goal-directed is 5.9x cheaper than learn-everything, and the names are not the knowledge
the_three_findings.evidence: learn every app's declaration: 13.49 s, 27 controls, 1,194 bytes. One goal-directed run: 2.30 s. Every app re-declares its names in 1.24 s, so a name cache buys exactly nothing: cold 2.15 s vs warm 2.17 s, 1.0 steps either way. 7 of 11 apps have a unique name set, which is why caching names is remembering the app rather than learning the interface.

what_survives_deletion.invariant: roles every app declares = ['link','textbox']; checkboxes and the all/active/completed filters appear only after work exists (0 of 11 declare them cold). That shape is the transferable fact.
what_survives_deletion.refusals: an address that resolved to nothing, and when -- cheap to keep, expensive to rediscover
not_kept: names (re-declared in 1.24 s by the app itself)
step sequence (a search over facts already held)

honest_limits: 11 apps of ONE specification. This is breadth within a family, not generalisation across families. A desktop application, a native GUI, or a browser-based IDE has a different declaration surface and none was tested.
The goal is supplied as strings the interface must declare. Turning a natural-language task into those strings is the organ this PR did NOT build, and it is the next bottleneck.
Single-step and three-step tasks only. Nothing here is long-horizon; OSWorld 2.1 tasks run beyond 250 agent steps and the constraint-tracking failure mode named by the benchmark is not exercised.

The postcondition check is 'the strings appear in the declaration'. That is exact and weak: it can be satisfied by a page that prints the string without doing the work, which is why the multi-step test also checks the URL.
Every number is producer-measured on one host, one browser build, no repeat trials. truth.achieved remains false.
The SWE-bench generation gap (1.4% search ceiling vs 78.80% top agent) is untouched by this work. A GUI organ does not fix an edit-synthesis gap.
